intent: Archive bucket_catch and poker-stakes out of testsAndMisc into testsAndMisc-archive, with full per-directory git history preserved, as the first (zero-risk) step of the repo restructure.
scope: Non-goal: billsplit is archived separately, since it is coupled to python_pkg/billsplit_coverage and the app_icons registry
changes: Extracted each directory with git filter-repo --path, preserving every commit that touched it (bucket_catch 10, poker-stakes 2 - both matching git log counts in the monorepo).
Merged both into kuhyx/testsAndMisc-archive with --allow-unrelated-histories, keeping original repo-relative paths as that archive already does for C/, CPP/, horatio/ and the rest.
Removed both trees plus poker-stakes-ci.yml from the monorepo (130 files, 21869 deletions) and dropped their rows from the AGENTS.md layout table.

verification.command: git ls-files <unit> | wc -l, in archive vs source

verification.evidence: No content differences for either unit (excluding untracked node_modules/build dirs that were never tracked).
bucket_catch and poker-stakes both listed alongside the pre-existing C, CPP, TS, horatio, linux_configuration, pomodoro_app, python_pkg, robotgo_demo, sonic_pi.
Depth violations dropped 556 -> 451, consistent with the 105 deep files these two units contributed.
No matches - no workflow still references a removed unit.
27 live reference lines, unchanged from baseline: neither unit had any systemd unit, /etc config or symlink pointing at it.

risks: The archive push is the only copy of these trees outside this repo's history; verified present via the GitHub API before deleting locally.

Historical planning notes (NEXT_SESSION_PROMPT.md, refactor_claude_todo_resume.md, docs/app-split-recipes.md) still mention both names. Left as-is: they are dated records of past work, not live configuration.
rollback: git revert the removal commit to restore both trees and the workflow.
The archive repo keeps its copy either way; re-verify with pre-commit run --all-files after any revert.
